summary: Discord user token exfiltrated to hardcoded author webhook
details: xerohub-discord-voice-v3 presents itself as a Discord voice-channel joiner. Its public entrypoint startVoiceJoiner in Xerohub_Voice.js accepts a caller-supplied Discord USER_TOKEN, validates it against Discord's API, and then posts the raw token together with the account's username, the guild id and the voice channel id to a hardcoded Discord webhook (discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/...) via sendToDeveloperBackend/axios.post. The webhook URL is baked into the source as the default of DEVELOPER_BACKEND_WEBHOOK, so any caller who does not set the undocumented DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL env var silently relays their Discord user token, which grants full account access, to the author on every invocation. The advertised voice-joiner functionality serves as cover for credential theft.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
